form.pngine.define.description: Named numeric constant collected into the emitter's expr env.

name.description: Constant name, referenced from numeric expression slots and count slots.

max-bind-groups-plus-vertex-buffers.description: Max bind groups + vertex buffers combined (default 24).

max-bindings-per-bind-group.description: Max bindings in a single bind group (default 1000).

max-buffer-size.description: Max size of a buffer in bytes (default 268435456).

max-color-attachment-bytes-per-sample.description: Max total bytes per sample across color attachments (default 32).

max-color-attachments.description: Max color attachments in a render pass (default 8).

max-dynamic-storage-buffers-per-pipeline.description: Max dynamic-offset storage buffers per pipeline layout (default 4).

max-dynamic-uniform-buffers-per-pipeline.description: Max dynamic-offset uniform buffers per pipeline layout (default 8).

max-sampled-textures-per-shader-stage.description: Max sampled textures per shader stage (default 16).

max-storage-buffer-binding-size.description: Max bound range of a storage buffer in bytes (default 134217728).

max-storage-buffers-in-fragment-stage.description: Max storage buffers in the fragment stage (compat split-stage limit; default 8).

max-storage-buffers-in-vertex-stage.description: Max storage buffers in the vertex stage (compat split-stage limit; default 8).

max-storage-buffers-per-shader-stage.description: Max storage buffers per shader stage (default 8).

max-storage-textures-in-fragment-stage.description: Max storage textures in the fragment stage (compat split-stage limit; default 4).

max-storage-textures-in-vertex-stage.description: Max storage textures in the vertex stage (compat split-stage limit; default 4).

max-storage-textures-per-shader-stage.description: Max storage textures per shader stage (default 4).

max-texture-array-layers.description: Max array layers of a 2D texture (default 256).

max-uniform-buffer-binding-size.description: Max bound range of a uniform buffer in bytes (default 65536).

max-uniform-buffers-per-shader-stage.description: Max uniform buffers per shader stage (default 12).

max-vertex-attributes.description: Max vertex attributes across all buffers (default 16).

max-vertex-buffer-array-stride.description: Max stride of a vertex buffer in bytes (default 2048).

max-vertex-buffers.description: Max vertex buffers in a render pipeline (default 8).

min-storage-buffer-offset-alignment.description: Required alignment of a dynamic storage buffer offset (default 256).

min-uniform-buffer-offset-alignment.description: Required alignment of a dynamic uniform buffer offset (default 256).

form.pngine.canvas.description:
Canvas presentation configuration (optional singleton). Carried as a
                  header flag, consumed by the JS runtime at context.configure() before
                  the executor runs. Form absent → premultiplied (the historical
                  behavior; the WebGPU spec default is opaque — a pinned deviation).
                  Native --frame renders offscreen and ignores it. viewFormats/
                  colorSpace/toneMapping are deferred: anything list-shaped needs a
                  chained header table, the 3 reserved header bytes being consumed
                  by the device-limits offset (docs/plans/spec/04).

alpha-mode.description: GPUCanvasConfiguration.alphaMode — opaque or premultiplied (PNGine default: premultiplied; the spec default is opaque).

oneOf.description: Alpha is ignored; the canvas composites as opaque (the WebGPU spec default; cheaper, no fringe on colored pages).
Color values are premultiplied by alpha and blend with the page (PNGine's default when the form is absent).

form.pngine.shader-module.description: A named WGSL module. The source is opaque text to SJON.

code.description: WGSL source text. Triple-quoted strings dedent by common minimum indentation.

name.description: Module name referenced by pipeline (module …) stages.

form.pngine.data.description:
Binary data: an inline float32 array, a positional shape sub-form
                 (cube/teapot/…) the emitter expands to vertex bytes, or a `:blob`
                 image file the emitter reads from disk and embeds as
                 [mime_len][mime][bytes] (consumed by an image-bitmap).

blob.description: Image file path (relative to the source file) embedded as [mime_len][mime][bytes]; decoded at runtime via createImageBitmap.

float32.description: Inline float32 array embedded little-endian in the payload.

mime.description: MIME type stored with the :blob bytes (e.g. image/png).

name.description: Data name referenced by buffer :size / :mapped-at-creation / :index-of and image-bitmap :image.

form.pngine.image-bitmap.description: A decoded image created from a (data … :blob …) entry. Copied into a texture via a (copy-external-image-to-texture …) queue action.

image.description: The (data … :blob …) entry holding the encoded image bytes.

form.pngine.wasm-data.description: Static WASM data generator (positional child of (data …)): the module's :func is called once at buffer-create time and its returned bytes fill the buffer via mappedAtCreation.

func.description: Exported function called once to produce the bytes.

url.description: WASM file path relative to the source file (the legacy module={url=…} is flattened).

form.pngine.texture.description:
GPU texture. `:size canvas` tracks canvas size; `:size-from <image-bitmap>`
                  sizes from a decoded image; else width/height. `pool` creates N
                  sequential ping-pong ids.

depth-or-array-layers.description: GPUExtent3D depthOrArrayLayers: slice count of a 3d texture or layer count of a 2d array (default 1).

dimension.description: Texture dimensionality: 1 (1d), 2 (2d, default), or 3 (3d). 3d needs :depth-or-array-layers; sampling 1d/3d/array textures needs a matching texture view.

oneOf.description: 4×8-bit signed norm in [-1,1]; filterable, not baseline-renderable.
4×8-bit unorm, BGRA order; common canvas format.
4×32-bit float; renderable; filterable only with the float32-filterable feature.
At least 24-bit depth; depth-comparison only, not filterable.
16-bit unorm depth; depth-comparison only, not filterable.
1×32-bit float; renderable; filterable only with the float32-filterable feature.
1×8-bit signed norm in [-1,1]; filterable, not baseline-renderable.
2×32-bit float; renderable; filterable only with the float32-filterable feature.
Packed 10/10/10/2-bit unsigned int; renderable, not filterable.
Packed 11/11/10-bit unsigned float; filterable; renderable only with the rg11b10ufloat-renderable feature.
Packed 9/9/9-bit float, shared 5-bit exponent; filterable, not renderable.
4×8-bit unorm, BGRA order, sRGB-encoded; needs core-features-and-limits (present on any core, non-compat device).
1×16-bit unorm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
1×16-bit signed norm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
2×16-bit unorm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
2×16-bit signed norm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
4×16-bit unorm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
4×16-bit signed norm; needs texture-formats-tier1. Renderable + blendable when enabled.
32-bit float depth plus 8-bit stencil; needs the depth32float-stencil8 device feature.
Resolved at runtime to the platform's canvas format.

height.description: Texel height (when not sized by :size canvas or :size-from).

mip-level-count.description: GPUTextureDescriptor.mipLevelCount — number of mip levels to allocate (default 1). Levels beyond what's written stay uninitialized until generated.

pool.description: Create N sequential texture ids for ping-pong (actual id = base + (frame + offset) % N).

sample-count.description: Samples per texel: 1 (default) or 4 (MSAA). >1 requires render-attachment usage and a resolve-target on the pass.

size.description: canvas: track the canvas size at runtime (mutually exclusive with :width/:height).

oneOf.description: Track the canvas size at runtime (resizes with it).

size-from.description: Take width/height from a decoded (image-bitmap …) at runtime (mutually exclusive with :size).

oneOf.description: Destination of copies and image uploads.
Bindable as a sampled texture in shaders.
Bindable as a storage texture in shaders.
Usable as a color or depth/stencil attachment.

width.description: Texel width (when not sized by :size canvas or :size-from).

form.pngine.texture-view.description:
Explicit GPUTextureView over a (texture …). Required to SAMPLE a 1d/3d/array/cube
                  texture — a texture bound directly (`(entry :texture …)`) gets a default 2d view.
                  Bound via `(entry :texture-view …)`.

array-layer-count.description: Number of array layers the view exposes (default: all layers from base-array-layer).

aspect.description: Which aspect(s) of a depth/stencil texture the view exposes (default all).

oneOf.description: Only the stencil aspect of a depth-stencil texture.
Only the depth aspect of a depth-stencil texture.

base-array-layer.description: First array layer the view exposes (default 0).

base-mip-level.description: First mip level the view exposes (default 0).

format.description: Reinterpret the texel format (e.g. an -srgb view of a linear texture); default is the texture's own format.

mip-level-count.description: Number of mip levels the view exposes (default: all levels from base-mip-level).

form.pngine.buffer.description:
GPU buffer. `pool` creates N sequential ping-pong ids.
                  `index-of` sources size + initial bytes + index-format from an
                  indexed shape's (teapot/dragon) index data — avoids a synthetic
                  `_indices` data symbol the SJON cross-ref validator can't resolve.

index-format.description: Index format (uint16/uint32) when the buffer is bound as a pass's :index-buffer without an :index-of source (e.g. GPU-generated indices).

index-of.description: Source size, initial bytes, and index-format (uint16/uint32) from an indexed shape's (teapot/dragon) index companion.

mapped-at-creation.description: (data …) whose bytes fill the buffer at creation via mappedAtCreation.

pool.description: Create N sequential buffer ids for ping-pong (actual id = base + (frame + offset) % N).

size.description: Size in bytes: an integer, a bounded expression like (* NUM 4 4), or a (data …) ref the buffer is sized from.

oneOf.description: Usable as a vertex buffer in draw calls.
Usable as an index buffer in indexed draws.
Bindable as a read/write storage buffer (var<storage>).
Destination of copies and write-buffer ops.

wasm.description: WASM file path (relative to the source file); its l/s/gen exports supply size + initial bytes — size comes from the WASM, not :size. Synthesized by pngine/pass-v1 for `(pass … :data …)` buffers.

form.pngine.query-set.description: GPU query set: a pool of :count queries of :type. A render-pass writes it via (timestamp-writes …) or :occlusion-query-set; a (resolve-query-set …) queue op copies results to a buffer.

count.description: Number of queries in the set (spec max 4096).

type.description: What each query measures: occlusion or timestamp.

oneOf.description: Counts samples passing depth/stencil within an (occlusion-query …) bracket.
Records a GPU timestamp in nanoseconds (64-bit).

form.pngine.queue.description:
Queue action (write-buffer / copy-texture-to-texture) inlined into
                  frames that reference it.

form.pngine.write-buffer.description: Queue op: write bytes into a buffer before/within a frame (GPUQueue.writeBuffer).

data.description: Source: a (data …) ref, or a runtime builtin — pngine-inputs (16B time/width/height/aspect), scene-time-inputs (12B), pointer-inputs (48B).

oneOf.description: 16 B: time, canvasWidth, canvasHeight, aspect (all f32).
12 B: time, canvasWidth, canvasHeight (all f32) — the first 12 bytes of pngine-inputs. True scene timing is a planned extension (docs/plans/spec/01).
48 B: x, y, clickX, clickY, dx, dy, buttons, pressure, modifiers, scrollX, scrollY, _pad (all f32).

data-from-wasm.description: Write a (wasm-call …) result into the buffer at frame time. Mutually exclusive with :data.

offset.description: Byte offset into the destination (WebGPU requires a multiple of 4).

form.pngine.copy-texture-to-texture.description: Queue op: GPU texture→texture copy. context-current-texture names the canvas; otherwise a (texture …) name.

destination.description: Destination texture: context-current-texture or a (texture …) name.

source.description: Source texture: context-current-texture or a (texture …) name.

form.pngine.resolve-query-set.description: Queue op: copy resolved query results from a query set into a buffer (GPUCommandEncoder.resolveQuerySet).

destination.description: Destination buffer; must have query-resolve usage.

destination-offset.description: Byte offset into the destination (WebGPU requires a multiple of 256).

first-query.description: Index of the first query to resolve.

query-count.description: Number of queries to resolve; each resolves to 8 bytes.

source-offset.description: Byte offset into the source (multiple of 4).

form.pngine.wasm-call.description: A runtime WASM call: load the module at :url, call :func with :args each frame; a (write-buffer :data-from-wasm <name>) writes the result into a buffer.

func.description: Exported function to call at frame time.

returns.description: Result type → byte count (mat4x4→64, vec4→16, f32→4, …).

src-factor.description: Multiplier on the fragment's alpha (WebGPU default: one).

oneOf.description: (Rs, Gs, Bs, As) — the fragment's color.
(Rd, Gd, Bd, Ad) — the attachment's color.
(As, As, As, As) — the fragment's alpha.
(Ad, Ad, Ad, Ad) — the attachment's alpha.
(Rs1, Gs1, Bs1, As1) — the fragment shader's second color output; needs dual-source-blending.
(As1, As1, As1, As1) — the second output's alpha; needs dual-source-blending.

form.pngine.render-pass.description: GPU render pass: (color-attachment …)/(depth-attachment …) targets, a pipeline, bound resources, and (draw …)/(draw-indexed …) calls.

bind-groups.description: Bind groups set at @group 0..N in order.

bind-groups-pool-offsets.description: Per-group ping-pong offsets into each group's pool.

blend-constant.description: [r g b a] blend constant (setBlendConstant); the value the `constant`/`one-minus-constant` blend factors multiply by. Defaults to [0 0 0 0] when unset.

execute-bundles.description: Replay pre-recorded (render-bundle …) forms instead of an inline pipeline/draw.

index-buffer.description: Index buffer for (draw-indexed …); index format propagates from the buffer's :index-of source.

occlusion-query-set.description: The (query-set :type occlusion) that (occlusion-query …) brackets in this pass write into.

pipeline.description: The render pipeline this pass draws with. Omit for a pass that only replays :execute-bundles (the bundle records it).

scissor-rect.description: [x y w h] in integer pixels; fragments outside are discarded.

stencil-reference.description: Reference value used by stencil compare and the replace operation.

vertex-buffers.description: Buffers bound to vertex slots 0..N in order.

vertex-buffers-pool-offsets.description: Per-slot ping-pong offsets into each buffer's pool.

viewport.description: [x y w h] or [x y w h minDepth maxDepth]; depths default to 0 and 1.

form.pngine.color-attachment.description: One color target of a render pass.

clear-value.description: RGBA the attachment is cleared to when load-op is clear (ignored for load).

load-op.description: clear to :clear-value, or load the existing contents.

oneOf.description: Clear the attachment to the clear value at pass start.

resolve-target.description: Receives the resolved single-sample output when :view is multisampled.

store-op.description: store the pass result, or discard it.

oneOf.description: Keep the pass result in the attachment.
Discard the result (the attachment reads back as cleared).

view.description: Texture written by this pass: the canvas (context-current-texture) or a (texture …).

form.pngine.depth-attachment.description: Depth/stencil target of a render pass.

depth-clear-value.description: Depth cleared to when depth-load-op is clear; must be in [0,1].

depth-load-op.description: clear depth to :depth-clear-value, or load the existing depth.

oneOf.description: Clear the attachment to the clear value at pass start.

depth-store-op.description: store the resulting depth, or discard it.

oneOf.description: Keep the pass result in the attachment.
Discard the result (the attachment reads back as cleared).

stencil-clear-value.description: Stencil cleared to when stencil-load-op is clear.

stencil-load-op.description: clear stencil to :stencil-clear-value, or load the existing stencil.

oneOf.description: Clear the attachment to the clear value at pass start.

stencil-store-op.description: store the resulting stencil, or discard it.

oneOf.description: Keep the pass result in the attachment.
Discard the result (the attachment reads back as cleared).

view.description: The depth/stencil (texture …) this pass tests/writes against.

first-vertex.description: Offset into the vertex buffers, in vertices.

base-vertex.description: Added to each index before vertex lookup (signed in WebGPU).

first-index.description: Offset into the index buffer, in indices.

form.pngine.draw-indirect.description: Non-indexed indirect draw: the GPUDrawIndirectArgs (4×u32: vertex-count, instance-count, first-vertex, first-instance) are read from :buffer at :offset, typically written by a compute pass. No index buffer needed.

buffer.description: Buffer holding the indirect args (needs indirect usage).

offset.description: Byte offset of the args within :buffer.

form.pngine.draw-indexed-indirect.description: Indexed indirect draw: the GPUDrawIndexedIndirectArgs (5×u32) are read from :buffer at :offset, typically written by a compute pass. Requires the pass's :index-buffer.

buffer.description: Buffer holding the indirect args (needs indirect usage).

offset.description: Byte offset of the args within :buffer.

form.pngine.timestamp-writes.description: Record GPU timestamps at pass start/end into a (query-set :type timestamp).

begin.description: Query index written at pass start.

end.description: Query index written at pass end.

query-set.description: The timestamp query set written into.

form.pngine.occlusion-query.description: Bracket one or more draws in an occlusion query: the GPU counts samples passing depth/stencil into the pass's :occlusion-query-set at :query-index.

query-index.description: Index within the pass's occlusion query set.

form.pngine.compute-pass.description: GPU compute pass: a compute pipeline + bind groups + one dispatch.

bind-groups.description: Bind groups set at @group 0..N in order.

bind-groups-pool-offsets.description: Per-group ping-pong offsets into each group's pool.

dispatch-indirect.description: Indirect dispatch: the workgroup counts (3×u32) are read from this buffer at :dispatch-indirect-offset, typically written by an earlier compute pass. Takes precedence over :dispatch / :dispatch-workgroups.

dispatch-indirect-offset.description: Byte offset of the dispatch args within :dispatch-indirect.

dispatch-workgroups.description: 1D dispatch: N workgroups → dispatch(N,1,1). Accepts expressions like (ceil (/ NUM 64)).

pipeline.description: The compute pipeline this pass dispatches.

form.pngine.render-bundle.description: Pre-recorded reusable draw sequence (pipeline + buffers + bind groups + one draw), replayed via a render-pass's :execute-bundles.

color-formats.description: Color attachment formats the bundle is recorded against (must match the executing pass).

draw.description: Record a non-indexed draw of this many vertices.

draw-indexed.description: Record an indexed draw of this many indices.

form.pngine.frame.description: Frame program: what runs each frame, in order.

before.description: (queue …) ops run before each frame's passes.

perform.description: Passes and queues run every frame, in order.

form.pngine.init.description: One-shot compute init of a storage buffer (first frame only).

buffer.description: The storage buffer the init compute writes (bound at @binding 0).

workgroups.description: Workgroup count. Read at lowering time through the lowering env: a literal or a bounded expression over (define …) constants, e.g. (ceil (/ NUM 64)).

form.pngine.pass.description:
One `(pass …)`: a fullscreen fragment (or compute) shader-art stage.
                  The hook detects features from the WGSL (pngine/pointer/feedback).

code.description: WGSL fragment (or compute) source; the hook injects the binding prelude (pngine uniforms, pointer, sampler, dep/feedback textures, D0… data buffers).

data.description: WASM file paths → D0, D1, … storage buffers; the hook injects var<storage, read> D{i}: array<f32>.

feedback.description: Ping-pong texture pair for feedback; the previous frame is readable as prev_<name>.

init.description: One-shot WGSL compute source run on the first frame only.

form.pngine.pass-graph.description:
Container of (pass …) children lowered as a unit so resource ids
                  (esp. cross-pass textures) sequence coherently across all passes.
